name: External script without Subresource Integrity
attack_scenario: the CDN (or any middlebox on the way to it) is compromised and serves a backdoored copy of the library to every user of the site; without an integrity hash the browser executes it blindly
negative_test_hint: load the page with a tampered library served from "https://cdn.example.com/lib.js" and assert the browser refuses it for an integrity mismatch

exemplar.explanation: An external <script> without integrity="sha384-..." executes whatever the CDN (or anyone who compromises it) serves. Subresource Integrity pins the expected hash so a tampered file is rejected by the browser.
